```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

breeding_sites <- read.csv('data/breeding_site_locations.csv')
gt(breeding_sites)
```

```{r}
colnames(breeding_sites)
glimpse(breeding_sites)

print(nrow(breeding_sites))
print(ncol(breeding_sites))
print(dim(breeding_sites))
```

```{r}
migration_sites <- read.csv('data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv')
gt(head(migration_sites))
```

```{r}
glimpse(migration_sites)
```

```{r}
breeding_filtered <- breeding_sites |> 
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)
gt(breeding_filtered)
```

```{r}
migration_filtered <- migration_sites |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat, Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude)
gt(migration_filtered)
```

```{r}
breeding_no_spain = breeding_filtered |> filter(Site != 'Spain')
gt(breeding_no_spain)
migration_no_spain = migration_filtered |> filter(Site != 'Spain')
gt(migration_no_spain)
```

```{r}
migration_summ <- migration_no_spain |> group_by(Site) |> summarise(across(everything(), median, na.rm = TRUE))
migration_summary <- migration_summ[, c('Site', 'Stopover_Longitude', 'Stopover_Latitude',
        'Iberian_Longitude', 'Iberian_Latitude',
        'Westmost_Longitude', 'Westmost_Latitude',
        'Winter_Longitude', 'Winter_Latitude')]
gt(migration_summary)
```

```{r}
combined_data <- full_join(breeding_no_spain, migration_summary)
gt(combined_data)
```

```{r}
combined_piv <- combined_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_piv)
```

```{r}
spring_data <- combined_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% c('Breeding', 'Stopover', 'Winter'))
autumn_data <- combined_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% c('Breeding', 'Iberian', 'Westmost', 'Winter'))

write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```
